title: Buddha
brief_description: Stone sculpture of Lord Buddha acquired from Rivona, Sanguem Taluka, Goa.
detailed_description: This sculpture represents Lord Buddha seated in a meditative posture, symbolizing enlightenment, inner peace, and spiritual wisdom. The serene facial expression and balanced composition reflect the artistic traditions of early medieval Buddhist sculpture. Acquired from Rivona in Sanguem Taluka, Goa, this 8th Century C.E. sculpture provides valuable evidence of the historical presence and influence of Buddhism in the region. It stands as an important example of religious art and the cultural diversity of early Goa.
